name: ts-module-equivalence-symlink-is-the-discriminator
body: In `scanner.test.ts` the relative/absolute `--module` equivalence case also passes under the pre-change lexical code (both spellings agree inside one temp dir); the symlinked-package case is the one that distinguishes physical from lexical resolution. Upgrade to a symlinked-root equivalence case if `cmd_scan` ever stops resolving the scan root before spawning.
